Auto-updating trigger ensures search_vector stays in sync. HNSW index (m=16, ef_construction=64) provides fast approximate nearest neighbor search. Partial index on completed analyses optimizes common queries.

architectural_decisions.decision: Issue #76 - LLM-based Topic Extraction vs Keyword Enhancement
architectural_decisions.rationale: Create dedicated LLM service for topic extraction instead of expanding keyword list. Keyword extraction (10 keywords in TECH_KEYWORDS) misses domain-specific topics like 'Socratic tutoring', 'binary quantization', 'supervisor pattern'. LLM extraction provides 3-5 specific, searchable topics per analysis with confidence scoring.

implementation.integration_point: After artifact_metadata extraction, before database storage

tradeoffs: Depends on LLM availability (mitigated by fallback)

architectural_decisions.rationale: Lightweight structlog-based metrics system with adaptive backpressure controls for embedding pipeline. Uses token bucket rate limiting, sliding window error tracking, and dynamic batch sizing to prevent 429/5xx errors. No Prometheus dependency - metrics emitted as JSON logs for CloudWatch/Loki ingestion. Provides p50/p95/p99 latency tracking, token count monitoring, and guardrails for vector validation.

technical_decisions.metrics_storage: In-memory aggregation (1000 samples) + JSONL log file
technical_decisions.rate_limiter: Token bucket (10k TPM default, configurable per OpenAI tier)
technical_decisions.batch_sizing: Adaptive (20 initial, 1-100 range, 50% decrease on 429, 10% increase when healthy)
technical_decisions.guardrails: Vector dimension validation + orphan chunk detection

migration_path: Phase 2 (Week 2): Backpressure - add rate limiter + error tracker
Phase 3 (Week 3): Adaptive controls - full batch sizer integration

architectural_decisions.rationale: Hybrid PII detection combining regex (fast path, < 2ms) with Microsoft Presidio (ML-based, 20-50ms) provides optimal balance of speed and accuracy. Two-stage detection: (1) Regex for common patterns (email, phone, SSN, credit card), (2) Presidio for contextual entities (names, organizations, locations). Fast path optimization skips Presidio when no PII detected by regex (90% of cases). Configurable sensitivity levels (low/medium/high) with allowlist support for false positives.

technical_decisions.stage_1: Regex pattern matching - zero dependencies, < 2ms latency
technical_decisions.stage_2: Presidio ML-based NER - 90-95% accuracy, spaCy backend
technical_decisions.optimization: Skip Presidio if regex finds nothing OR text < 1000 chars
technical_decisions.blocking_mode: Configurable: BLOCK (raise error) or WARN (log + continue)
technical_decisions.privacy: Never log actual PII text - only types and confidence scores
technical_decisions.allowlist: Support for known false positives (example.com, localhost)

configuration_knobs.PII_ALWAYS_RUN_PRESIDIO: Run Presidio even if regex finds nothing
